environment.evidence: Sustainability is at the core of the Company’s long-term success, and it is embedded throughout our business.

community.evidence: devoting time and resources to charitable causes – wherever our people live and work – has been central to our corporate culture

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, third-person business description of scale, headquarters and services. Values are thin: sustainability and charitable giving are stated as priorities in single sentences, with absolute wording ('at the core', 'central'). Limited first-person plural, mainly 'our business' and 'our people'. No customer, safety or integrity commitments appear.
